753:t_066:1.en:
$$ジン$$
「It's the same as $$エンシェントＡＱ$$'s Divine Infinity Palm! Cause and effect are reversed!」

753:t_066:2.en:
$$カグラ$$
「The one where the result of a hit comes before the attack itself!?」

753:t_066:3.en:
$$シリウス$$
「An attack that can't be dodged...! It truly is the judgment of a god!」

753:t_066:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「After everything we've been through, we're not going to be scared by a cheap trick like this!」

753:t_066:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「If we can't dodge it all, there's no use thinking about it! Let's take him down before we run out of strength!」

753:t_066:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「If you say you won't do it because it's impossible, shouldn't you give up this battle itself?」

753:t_066:7.en:
$n
「Do you have time to run your mouth, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_066:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「This is a word of advice, $n. You could even call it mercy born of my affection for you all.」

753:t_066:9.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「If you won't stop resisting, I will have to give you even more punishment. I recommend that you give up quickly.」

753:t_066:10.en:
$n
「I won't fall for words like that!」

753:t_066:11.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then it can't be helped. Every minute, you will learn that my power is infinite.」

753:t_066:12.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「This is not a threat. I am merely stating a fact.」

753:t_067:0.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Wh-what!? There are more of them than in the attack a minute ago, and they hit harder too!」

753:t_067:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I told you. That you would come to know my infinite power every minute.」

753:t_067:2.en:
$$隼人$$
「Watch out! The attack a minute from now will be even stronger!」

753:t_067:3.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Damn! So he's on a whole different level from any monster we've fought so far!」

753:t_067:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So you should give up quickly. Then at least I can embrace you before you feel any pain.」

753:t_067:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is the last mercy I will give you.」

753:t_068:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「One minute left until the universe collapses!」

753:t_068:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「Hurry, everyone! If we don't stop $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ in this one minute, it's all over!」

753:t_068:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We'll do it! Otherwise we couldn't look in the eye the people who entrusted the future to us!」

753:t_068:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「You bet! Let's do it, everyone!」

753:t_068:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm staking everything on this one minute! Even our lives!」

753:t_069:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「It seems it's beginning.」

753:t_069:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Farewell, $c... I will pass down the tale of you, who kept resisting me, at the end of myth, as the last $$バアル$$.」

753:t_100:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「You go around calling yourself a god! Aren't you ashamed!?」

753:t_100:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I have the power, the spirit and the resolve to match the title now. I say it with pride.」

753:t_100:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I am a god, $$勝平$$.」

753:t_100:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「Shut up! I can't live alongside a guy who can kill people while laughing!」

753:t_100:4.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「That's right, $$勝平$$! If we don't beat this guy, it's the end of the universe!」

753:t_100:5.en:
$$恵子$$
「We have to do it! For the Earth... for everyone in the universe!」

753:t_100:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I exist to free you from your sense of duty to that fight.」

753:t_100:7.en:
$$勝平$$
「Shut up, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We're not fighting out of duty! We're here by our own will!」

753:t_100:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「We fight! To protect what matters to us from guys like you!」

753:t_100:9.en:
$$勝平$$
「Let's go, $$ザンボット３$$! This is truly, genuinely the final battle!!」

753:t_101:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$万丈$$... You who bear the Sun, your fighting spirit, your courage... and your strong will are worthy of praise.」

753:t_101:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「I'm honored to catch a god's eye. Though I have no intention of recognizing you as a god.」

753:t_101:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then let me envelop your sun in mine. That way, you too will recognize a being greater than yourself.」

753:t_101:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「Even if you surpass me in power, you can't break my spirit!」

753:t_101:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「And there is no defeat for me! I'll teach you that!」

753:t_101:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「With the end of the universe closing in, you can still burn with such fighting spirit. You really don't know when to quit...!」

753:t_101:6.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We will not accept the end of the universe!」

753:t_101:7.en:
$$万丈$$
「For the world, for the people, for the universe, $$ダイターン３$$ shatters a god's ambitions!」

753:t_101:8.en:
$$万丈$$
「If you're not afraid of the brilliance of this Sun, come on!!」

753:t_102:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Rest assured, $$ワッ太$$. Soon all your petty worries and anxieties will vanish. You too will cast off your body and set out for a new world.」

753:t_102:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't decide that on your own! I have no intention of losing to homework or a bankruptcy crisis!」

753:t_102:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「And while we're at it, to a selfish god like you too!」

753:t_102:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「A god has the right to decide everything. No, a god must decide everything.」

753:t_102:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I resolved to do that, and so I became a being who surpasses the $$御使い$$s!」

753:t_102:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'm a president too, but I run $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ by joining forces with everyone around me!」

753:t_102:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That's way more fun! A dictator of a one-man show like you wouldn't understand!」

753:t_102:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So a human, the head of a small company at that, can't understand my resolve!」

753:t_102:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You call yourself a god, but you don't understand me or humans at all!」

753:t_102:9.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Let's go, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! To protect our company safe, the Earth and the peace of the universe, $$トライダー$$ and I will take you down!!」

753:t_103:0.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Everyone, this is the crucial moment!」

753:t_103:1.en:
$$厚井$$
「I know! We're ready, in preparation and in resolve!」

753:t_103:2.en:
$$木下$$
「L-let's do it, everyone! Let's go out with a bang, a bang!」

753:t_103:3.en:
$$郁絵$$
「With the power of us... of $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$, let's save this universe!」

753:t_103:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Summoning the last shreds of courage to challenge a god... That sight goes beyond endearing. It's almost comical.」

753:t_103:5.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Silence! You are the one about to be defeated by us!」

753:t_103:6.en:
$$柿小路$$
「The universe's jack-of-all-trades, $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$! We'll fight to the end alongside our President!!」

753:t_104:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It's the final showdown, $$鉄人$$! Let's defeat $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and protect the universe!」

753:t_104:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Even if you defeat me, the collapse of the universe won't stop... And even if it did, all that awaits in a world with neither $$御使い$$s nor a god is disorderly chaos.」

753:t_104:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「People could never live in a world like that!」

753:t_104:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Don't decide on your own that humanity will perish!」

753:t_104:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It's true there are bad people...! But there are far more kind and righteous people in this world!」

753:t_104:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$正太郎$$... Though you saw the ugly underside of humanity at such a young age, why can you still believe so much?」

753:t_104:7.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I'm not like you! I love people and this world! That's why I can believe!」

753:t_104:8.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do it, $$鉄人$$! Let's summon our last strength to protect the world we love!!」

753:t_105:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「There is no need to be so frightened. I intend to give great love to organic and inorganic alike, without distinction.」

753:t_105:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Even you reject my salvation?」

753:t_105:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$オックス$$ can feel it too! That you're the enemy of us... of everything that exists!」
